text.content:
A cartel peace summit that ended in a massacre.

When: 2058
Where: The Moto Cielo motor hotel, Vista del Rey
Who was involved: Every cartel network left in Night City
What it changed: The Valentinos were the only cartel network left standing

When the shooting stopped, the Valentinos ruled the cartels; after that you joined, you died, or you got out of the life. The motor hotel is still standing, burned black (SC 2). The Valentinos keep it as a memorial and a warning, and nobody touches it. Ghost stories come free.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 04, 10
